scenes.title: Level 10: Fingerpicking
scenes.subtitle: Thumb and fingers
lines: Today, we'll explore arpeggios with your thumb and fingers, and master alternating bass — the heart of Travis-picking.

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll play arpeggios using your thumb and fingers in the pattern p-i-m-a.
You'll also use alternating bass notes, like Travis-picking, to add rhythm and movement to your playing.
Let's begin with the p-i-m-a pattern — the foundation of fingerpicking.
